label: Move window to space 1, stay here
description: Sends the focused window to space 1 and keeps you on the space you are on.

label: Move window to space 2, stay here
description: Sends the focused window to space 2 and keeps you on the space you are on.

label: Move window to space 9, stay here
description: Sends the focused window to space 9 and keeps you on the space you are on.

label: Move window to space 10, stay here
description: Sends the focused window to space 10 and keeps you on the space you are on.

label: Next space on this screen
description: Goes to the next space on the screen you are on, back to the first after the last.

label: Previous space on this screen
description: Goes to the previous space on the screen you are on, round to the last from the first.

label: Last space you were on
description: Goes back to the space you were on before, like ⌘ Tab does for apps.

label: Focus window west
description: Moves the focus to the window to the left of the focused one; at the edge it moves to the next screen.

label: Focus window east
description: Moves the focus to the window to the right of the focused one; at the edge it moves to the next screen.

label: Focus window north
description: Moves the focus to the window above the focused one; at the edge it moves to the next screen.

label: Focus window south
description: Moves the focus to the window below the focused one; at the edge it moves to the next screen.

label: Swap window west
description: Swaps the focused window with the one to the left of it; the focus stays on your window.

label: Swap window east
description: Swaps the focused window with the one to the right of it; the focus stays on your window.

label: Swap window north
description: Swaps the focused window with the one above it; the focus stays on your window.

label: Swap window south
description: Swaps the focused window with the one below it; the focus stays on your window.

label: Focus the screen west
description: Moves the focus to the screen on the left.

label: Focus the screen east
description: Moves the focus to the screen on the right.

label: Send window to the screen west
description: Sends the focused window to the screen on the left and follows it.

label: Send window to the screen east
description: Sends the focused window to the screen on the right and follows it.

label: Close window
description: Closes the focused window, like ⌘ W in most apps.

label: Toggle tiled / floating
description: Lifts the focused window out of the tiling so it floats; press again to tile it back.

label: Fullscreen inside the space
description: Makes the focused window fill the space while the others wait behind it; the outline turns amber. Press again to restore.

label: Full width (fill the parent split)
description: Makes the focused window fill its parent split, such as the whole width of a stack. Press again to restore.

label: Pin: floating, on top, on every space
description: Keeps the focused window floating, above the others and on every space. Press again to unpin. Needs the scripting addition.

label: Toggle the scratchpad
description: Shows or hides the scratchpad window, a window kept out of the way until you call it. Needs the scripting addition.

label: Send window to the scratchpad
description: Makes the focused window the scratchpad window and hides it until fn + s brings it back.

label: Narrower
description: Makes the focused window narrower by moving its side split.

label: Wider
description: Makes the focused window wider by moving its side split.

label: Shorter
description: Makes the focused window shorter by moving the split above or below it.

label: Taller
description: Makes the focused window taller by moving the split above or below it.

label: Focused window and its neighbour side by side (|)
description: Places the focused window and its neighbour side by side, split by a vertical line.

label: Focused window and its neighbour one above the other (\)
description: Places the focused window and its neighbour one above the other, split by a horizontal line.

label: Focused and its neighbour side by side, focused on the left
description: Arranges the focused window and its neighbour side by side, with the focused one on the left.

label: Focused and its neighbour side by side, focused on the right
description: Arranges the focused window and its neighbour side by side, with the focused one on the right.

label: Focused and its neighbour one above the other, focused on top
description: Arranges the focused window and its neighbour one above the other, with the focused one on top.

label: Focused and its neighbour one above the other, focused at the bottom
description: Arranges the focused window and its neighbour one above the other, with the focused one at the bottom.

label: Toggle tiled / floating layout
description: Switches this space between tiled (windows share the screen) and floating (windows stay where you put them).

label: Balance the splits
description: Gives every window in this space an equal share again after resizing.

label: Rotate the layout clockwise
description: Turns the whole layout of this space a quarter clockwise: side by side becomes one above the other.

label: Rotate the layout counter-clockwise
description: Turns the whole layout of this space a quarter counter-clockwise.

label: New Ghostty window
description: Opens a new Ghostty window on the focused screen, also when Ghostty is already in front.

label: New tab in the default browser
description: Opens a new tab in the default browser's front window, or a first window when it has none.

label: New default browser window
description: Opens a new window of the default browser on the focused screen.

label: Finder
description: Opens Finder, or brings it to the front when it is already running.

label: Claude
description: Opens Claude, or brings it to the front when it is already running.

label: Visual Studio Code
description: Opens Visual Studio Code, or brings it to the front when it is already running.

label: Gemini
description: Opens Gemini, or brings it to the front when it is already running.

label: Neovim
description: Opens Neovim in a new Ghostty window.

label: Raycast Notes (instead of Quick Note)
description: Opens Raycast Notes; this key no longer opens macOS's Quick Note.

label: Show these hotkeys
description: Opens this list: every fn-layer hotkey, searchable, with what it does.

label: System: lock, sleep, restart
description: Opens the kb System list: lock the screen, sleep or restart.

label: Page Up
description: Scrolls one page up, for keyboards without a Page Up key.

label: Page Down
description: Scrolls one page down, for keyboards without a Page Down key.
